test_suite.description: measurements holds the numbers from data.txt
test_suite.hint_not_defined: Read data.txt with readlines and parse each line as a Float64.
test_suite.hint_wrong_size: data.txt has 4 lines, so measurements should have 4 numbers.

test_suite.hint_wrong_type: Define a struct Point with fields x and y, then origin_shift = Point(1.0, -2.0).
test_suite.hint_tolerance: Check the signs of x and y.

test_suite.hint_tolerance_julia: Use gamma from SpecialFunctions: gamma(x + 1) / gamma(x).

test_suite.description: trapezoid(f, 0, 1, 1000) integrates x^2 (a function as input)
test_suite.hint_tolerance: Weight the two end points by 1/2 and all interior points by 1.

test_suite.description: summary_stats returns a named tuple (mean=..., std=...)
test_suite.hint_tolerance: Use mean and std from the Statistics standard library.

test_suite.description: column_sums of a 2×3 matrix (each inner list is a row)
test_suite.hint_wrong_size: There is one sum per column, so the result has 3 numbers.
test_suite.hint_tolerance: Sum down each column: sum(A; dims=1).
